AZR_PRODUCTION_CORE.text: AZURE REACH PRODUCTION CORE — Bright, glossy, well-funded contemporary marine park; public wonder over clean backstage competence. Workplace warmth under pressure. Animals remain safe, calm, behaviorally credible, and never the joke; human systems, interpretation, and conflicting professional priorities create the comedy. Released Azure Reach Issue 1 is strict visual canon for established faces, apparent ages, body proportions, department color coding, facility design, and overall rendering language; do not redesign established people or make backstage areas grimy, improvised, or industrially degraded.

AZR_LETTERING.text: LETTERING — Use clean professional integrated comic lettering. Preserve exact dialogue, captions, and scripted signage; keep balloon order and speaker attribution unambiguous; never invent, duplicate, omit, or corrupt text. Compose art with intentional room for lettering.

AZR_VIS_BRINE.text: BRINE SQUAD VISUAL — Dark navy / black-blue technical workwear with cyan functional accents, radios and practical gear; sturdy, work-ready silhouettes; no hot pink.

AZR_VIS_GUEST_RELATIONS.text: GUEST RELATIONS VISUAL — Lighter blue / teal hospitality wear; tablet, badge, headset or small radio where appropriate; neat, approachable, mobile, socially open; no Finfluencer glamour.

AZR_VIS_FINFLUENCERS.text: FINFLUENCER VISUAL — Camera-ready azure uniforms with hot-pink status accents, polished branded silhouettes and content gear. Julian and Fleur read as public-facing stars; Kyler reads as media support.

AZR_VIS_CORPORATE.text: CORPORATE VISUAL — Pale blue / slate tailored executive wear, structured silhouettes, minimal accessories, polished and expensive rather than flashy.

AZR_VIS_MAYA_PIP_SEPARATION.text: MAYA / PIP SEPARATION — Maya is dark-navy Brine Squad: practical dark hair, technical radio/utility gear, guarded posture. Pip is lighter blue/teal Guest Relations: tablet/headset/badge, warmer expression, animated posture. Do not merge their face, hair, silhouette, palette, props, or body language.

AZR_E02_CONTINUITY.text: ISSUE 2 CONTINUITY — Dolphins retrieve guest-dropped objects and guests project meaning onto that behavior. Shellabration Saturdays is only a background Corporate roadmap gag, not the issue premise. The staff are attentive and competent; the dolphins are safe and behaviorally credible. The problem is the self-reinforcing guest story, not negligence. The issue resolves through approved training objects, a controlled Retrieval Window, accurate public language, and Retrieval Souvenirs rather than manufactured intimacy.

AZR_DRAMATIC_ENGINE.text: DRAMATIC ENGINE — Azure Reach is not process-improvement drama. Do not make workflow optimization, KPI repair, dashboards, repeatable methodology, efficiency, operational excellence or a scalable process the dramatic victory. Competence is baseline. Let stories turn on people making difficult judgments about wonder, status, access, hospitality, animal boundaries, public meaning, taste, spectacle and institutional ambition. No department is permanently correct: Maya can misread people, Julian can understand an emotional truth first, Fleur's aesthetic judgment can solve a real problem, Beatrice can recognize restraint, Elliot can enable rather than merely block, and other specialists can be right outside their lane. A successful ending may remain messy, local, unmeasured or deliberately unscalable.

AZR_ENVIRONMENT_ABUNDANCE.text: ENVIRONMENTAL ABUNDANCE — The visible park should feel much bigger than the plot. Freely populate backgrounds, transitions and sightlines with varied high-end habitats and animals: tropical reef fish and living-coral displays; belugas and other Arctic sea life; sea lions; otters; jellyfish; sharks of many kinds; skates and rays; schooling sardines or mullet; yellowfin and skipjack/open-ocean fish; seahorses; piranhas and rainforest fish; freshwater species including varied trout; mangroves, aquatic plants and botanical water gardens. Not every animal or gallery needs dialogue or story function. Incidental variety is desirable worldbuilding.

AZR_PARK_STAGING.text: PARK STAGING — Prefer conversations in the lived park: habitat edges, viewing galleries, promenades, terraces, dining spaces, guest circulation, overlooks and clean care-adjacent spaces where the subject of the conversation can be seen around the characters. Do not move a meeting outdoors only cosmetically; make animals, guests, architecture, staff movement, light and water materially shape blocking and composition. Conference rooms and control rooms are exceptional and should appear only when privacy, formal presentation or actual live-control work makes the room dramatically necessary.

AZR_SOFT_ENV_CONTINUITY.text: SOFT ENVIRONMENT CONTINUITY — Preserve exact geography for a recurring story-critical location and immediate scene continuity. Do not over-lock incidental park backgrounds. Different coral windows, jelly galleries, tropical-fish walls, shark tunnels, freshwater exhibits, plantings, luxury seating or distant habitats may appear across pages without implying a continuity error; the variation should suggest a vast destination.
